evals.prompt: Draw our checkout architecture in the Carbon style. A React web app and a mobile app call an API gateway in AWS us-east-1. Behind the gateway there's an orders service and a payments service; payments calls Stripe, which is outside AWS. Orders writes to Postgres, both services publish to a Kafka topic, and a notification worker consumes it. Save it as docs/checkout.d2 and render an SVG next to it.
evals.expected_output: A valid architecture inkline file with a carbon header, containers for AWS/region, roles and domain classes on nodes, and a rendered SVG.
assertions: The diagram is saved at docs/checkout.d2
The header declares diagram: architecture and design_system: carbon
The file renders with inkline without errors
A rendered SVG sits next to the source in docs/
At least three different Carbon domain classes are used (e.g. application, data, network)
AWS / us-east-1 is a container holding the gateway and services, and Stripe is outside it
No hand-set colours or shapes (no style.fill / style.stroke / shape: overrides on nodes)

evals.prompt:
can you turn this mermaid into a inkline diagram and give me light + dark svgs?

stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Draft
  Draft --> InReview: submit
  InReview --> Draft: request changes
  InReview --> Approved: approve
  Approved --> Published: publish
  Published --> Archived: archive
  Archived --> [*]
evals.expected_output: A state inkline file using quoted "[*]" pseudo-states and labelled transitions, rendered in both themes.
assertions: All six transitions are present with their labels (submit, request changes, approve, publish, archive)
The file renders with inkline without errors
Two SVGs exist, one light and one dark (different canvas colours)

evals.prompt: I need a swimlane for our refund process, lanes as rows please. Customer requests a refund, Support reviews it. If it's over $500 Finance has to approve, otherwise Support approves it directly. Then the Payments system issues the refund and the customer gets an email. Render it to refund.svg.
evals.expected_output: A swimlanes inkline file with horizontal orientation, steps inside lanes, a decision with labelled branches, start/end roles, rendered without errors.
assertions: The header declares diagram: swimlanes and orientation: horizontal
There are lanes for Customer, Support, Finance and Payments
The $500 branch is a decision with two labelled outgoing connections
Start and end steps use the start and end roles
The file renders with inkline without errors
